draft_text: Asterion outperformed RuneSpan on Meridian-QA, while Darsen and Ko reported that Patchwise Replay improves exact-match accuracy on the same benchmark.
revised_text: Asterion achieved higher mean exact-match accuracy (80.4%) than RuneSpan (78.0%) on Meridian-QA, while Darsen and Ko described applying Patchwise Replay in a preliminary experiment.
rationale: Table T1 shows Asterion mean 80.4 vs RuneSpan 78.0, a 2.4pp gain, supporting "outperformed" as a mean difference. However, no statistical test is reported, so "outperformed" implying significance is unsupported. Also, P1 only describes a preliminary experiment applying Patchwise Replay; it does not report that it improves accuracy on Meridian-QA.
